title: fix(go): resolve read signer for EVM allowance short-circuit
quote: The exact and upto ERC-20 approval paths asserted ClientEvmSignerWithReadContract directly, so a signer constructed without an RPC client (HasRPCClient() == false) issued a doomed allowance read, and a configured RPCURL/RPCByChainID fallback was never used for the check. Resolve through resolveReadSigner, matching batch-settlement and the EIP-2612 path.

title: [Bug]: Python SIWX hook looks up has_record_nonce (nonexistent method), so the nonce anti-replay check silently breaks
quote: create_siwx_request_hook never executes a storage's record_nonce, so SIWX message signatures are replayable, and per the documented storage contract a correct implementation is rejected at startup.

title: [Bug]: Go facilitator drops the abort-hook Message from V2 verify/settle errors
quote: When a V2 facilitator hook returns {Abort: true, Reason, Message}, the reason reaches the resource server but the message is silently dropped, so operators lose whatever diagnostic the hook author set.

title: fix(core): isolate facilitator lifecycle hook errors
quote: Wrap all six facilitator hook loops so a throwing hook is logged and skipped, mirroring the resource server's handling.

title: fix(go): trim trailing slash from facilitator URL
quote: With URL: "https://host/", the Go facilitator client sends requests to //verify and //settle. Routers that don't clean paths, such as gin, return 404, so payments fail. The TypeScript and Python clients already strip the trailing slash.
